title: ☕ CUPAIO v6.9.1 IS HERE
content:
A cleaner look. A new way to win.

✦ CLEAN & MINIMAL
Enjoy a refreshed interface and a streamlined startup.

✦ NEW: WIN CHECKER
Check your Amazon invites and automatically attempt a one-item checkout when Buy Now becomes available. Successful purchases are shared on Discord and added to your dashboard.

✦ NOW ON macOS
Cupaio is now available for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

Download v6.9.1 for your platform and get ready for your next drop.
